name: chromium-extension-audit
title: Chromium Extensions Audit
description: Audit Chromium browser extensions, understand their permissions, and monitor security-relevant changes locally.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: browser-extensions
commands.title: Browser Extensions
commands.subtitle: Chromium Extensions Audit
commands.description: Inspect Chromium browser extensions across browsers and profiles, review capabilities and changes, and manage your local baseline

commands.name: extension-changes
commands.title: Extension Changes
commands.subtitle: Chromium Extensions Audit
commands.description: Monitor unreviewed extension changes in the menu bar with best-effort hourly scans

preferences.name: analyzeCode
preferences.title: Code Analysis
preferences.label: Scan extension code locally
preferences.description: Read each extension's installed JavaScript and HTML to detect remote code loading, obfuscation, dynamic code, referenced hosts, and code changed without a version update. Files are never executed or uploaded. Scans take longer.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
